core.headline: New three-bedroom semi, Kings Hill – spring 2027 completion
core.listing:
A new-build three-bedroom semi-detached house in Kings Hill, West Malling, with an air source heat pump, EV charging point and 10-year NHBC warranty. Completion is expected in spring 2027.

The ground floor has a kitchen/dining room measuring 5.80m x 3.40m (19'0" x 11'2") and a living room measuring 4.90m x 3.30m (16'1" x 10'10"). Underfloor heating runs throughout the ground floor. The first floor has three bedrooms, including a principal bedroom measuring 4.10m x 3.00m (13'5" x 9'10") with an en-suite, and a family bathroom. Radiators heat the first floor.

Outside is a turfed rear garden with a patio. Two allocated parking spaces are included, with an EV charging point.

West Malling station is approx. 2 miles away.

Fixed Price £410,000. Freehold. Council Tax: not yet banded (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). Predicted EPC rating B. Construction: brick and block under a tiled roof. Mains electricity, water (metered) and sewerage. Heating by air source heat pump; underfloor heating downstairs, radiators upstairs. FTTP broadband. No onward chain. EPC B is a predicted rating (SAP); the final EPC will be issued on completion. Reservation fee £1,500, deducted from the price on completion; refundable less a £250 administration fee if the buyer withdraws within 28 days, otherwise non-refundable. Estate charge £295 per year to the management company for communal open space. Developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring for reservations by 30 November 2026.
core.summary: New-build semi-detached house in Kings Hill with air source heat pump, EV charging point, two allocated parking spaces and 10-year NHBC warranty. Completion expected spring 2027. Freehold, no chain.

EV charging point and two allocated parking spaces
Developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring (ends 30 Nov 2026)
